provenance.source: NCF official release 150_20_hist.npy (150 ADE20K classes x 20 palettes)
provenance.bin_convention: RGB bin centre = index / 32, matching dataset/get_lib.py
provenance.moments: computed analytically from histogram weights, not from a reconstructed x_H
provenance.limitation: no ADE20K segmentation is run, so every record is collapsed onto 'global_scene' and the paper's area-weighted per-class mixture (Eq. 7) degenerates to a single draw over all 3000 distributions; ade20k_class is retained per record
